items.subject: Security alert
items.summary: Google issued two near-identical alerts confirming that Gemini Email Triage was granted access to some Google Account data.
items.action: Confirm that you authorised Gemini Email Triage. If not, open Google Account Connections and Security directly, revoke the app’s access, review recent activity and secure the account.
items.decisionNeeded: Whether Gemini Email Triage was intentionally granted access to the Google Account.
